plain_language.what_did_we_find: Both selected implementation profiles matched the named-variable model for all 10,000 records, including 15,000 intermediate/final outputs per profile. The corpus has 5,091 distinct structural operation inputs. No differing output or process-control failure occurred in the 40 scientific processes.
plain_language.is_it_interesting: Yes as a reusable, independently checked variable-operation corpus; it found no implementation problem. Agreement on these finite, syntactically scoped inputs does not prove either implementation or the model correct.
plain_language.does_it_require_more_work: Retain the model, auditor and corpus as local regression assets; no external issue or contribution follows from this result. Complete the required full repository suite, refresh and project-wide successor review before delivery. The next queue item is a separate question.

findings.independent_replay: The new read-only audit imports none of the producer, named model, expectation auditor or runner. It checks canonical type-sensitive JSON equality of every raw output with already independently audited expected trees, exact 500-row batch/full-corpus equality, 40-cell profile/order membership, all IDs/stage counts and recorded result summaries.
findings.raw_custody: All 40 input and receipt bindings, 80 raw stdout/stderr hashes/lengths and 40 comparison files agree with the committed result. Every argv matches the selected profile and exact batch path. No missing, extra, duplicated or malformed output was accepted.
findings.process_control: All 40 scientific processes exited zero with empty stderr, positive sampled RSS and preflight backend samples, no timeout/memory/monitor fault and successful group cleanup. Each stayed below 180 seconds and the 3-GiB ceiling.
findings.adoption_and_scope: Four prewritten records remain adopted unchanged under reviewed repair; full corpus selection, 2,000 capture-collision cases and 20 syntax/operation strata remain intact. Repeated records, untyped syntax and source maxima12 nodes/depth2 limit generality.
findings.repair_history: Earlier unsupervised preparation compile failure and unknown exact costs/R1 source binding, prefreeze selected-fixture incident and sandbox RSS failure remain evidence. They are not scientific negative results or erased by this success.
findings.recommendation: Retain the exact local regression package at normal priority for future operation/API changes. No distinguishing case exists to minimize, no current implementation defect is established, and no external action is warranted from these observations.
findings.remaining_closure: Full current/historical suite, registered portable replay checks, dependency-ordered refresh/freshness, whole-project successor selection and main-only delivery still require their own evidence.

metrics.cost_limit: Recorded process time excludes unknown preparation/reviewer time and is not a benchmark or performance comparison.
